description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable.

not_on_questionnaire.title: Not on questionnaire
not_on_questionnaire.description: The source dictionary's own code: this field was not asked on the participant's questionnaire version (Aqua/Blue/Other). Adopted verbatim from the source, not invented — D001.

missing_numeric.title: Missing
missing_numeric.description: No value recorded, for a field the source dictionary documents no missing/unknown code for. Agent-decided generic sentinel, steward-confirmed as the package's policy for this gap — D002.
